```{r setup, include=FALSE}
metadata <- read.delim("data/metadata/mehreen_metadata_fixed.txt",
                       check.names = FALSE)
metadata <- metadata[, !is.na(names(metadata)) & nzchar(names(metadata)),
                     drop = FALSE]
metadata$Diet <- factor(metadata$Diet, levels = c("33", "50", "83"))
metadata$Treatment <- factor(metadata$Treatment, levels = c("Control", "Infected"))

counts_table <- read.delim(
  "output/rmd_runs/transcript-exon-primary-deseq2_20260806-004620/host_counts_no_rrna.tsv",
  check.names = FALSE
)
placement <- read.delim(
  "output/runs/host_pathogen_dual_20260727_000952/local-analysis/host-mapping-audit_20260729-163928/unified-model/audit-summary/host_gene_sequence_placement.tsv",
  check.names = FALSE
)
rrna_ids <- trimws(readLines("data/excluded_loci/gregaria_rrna_list.txt"))
rrna_ids <- rrna_ids[nzchar(rrna_ids) & !startsWith(rrna_ids, "#")]
all_non_rrna_ids <- setdiff(counts_table$gene_id, rrna_ids)
main_chromosome_ids <- placement$gene_id[
  placement$sequence_class == "Nuclear chromosome" &
    !placement$gene_id %in% rrna_ids
]
all_counts <- counts_table[counts_table$gene_id %in% all_non_rrna_ids, ]
placed_counts <- counts_table[counts_table$gene_id %in% main_chromosome_ids, ]
```

```{r metrics, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
n_samples <- nrow(metadata)
n_all_genes <- nrow(all_counts)
n_placed_genes <- nrow(placed_counts)
diet_levels <- paste(levels(droplevels(metadata$Diet)), collapse = " / ")
treatment_levels <- paste(levels(droplevels(metadata$Treatment)), collapse = " / ")

cat('<div class="metric-grid">')
cat(sprintf('<div class="metric"><span>%s</span><strong>samples</strong></div>', n_samples))
cat(sprintf('<div class="metric"><span>%s</span><strong>all non-rRNA loci</strong></div>',
            format(n_all_genes, big.mark = ",")))
cat(sprintf('<div class="metric"><span>%s</span><strong>placed chromosome loci</strong></div>',
            format(n_placed_genes, big.mark = ",")))
cat(sprintf('<div class="metric"><span>%s</span><strong>diet x treatment groups</strong></div>',
            length(unique(interaction(metadata$Diet, metadata$Treatment)))))
cat('</div>')
```

## How To Read This Site

<div class="note-panel">
<p>
Start with the shared design, workflow, and QC pages. Then choose one analysis
scope and keep that scope consistent through DEG testing, overlap, catalogue,
and enrichment. The placed-chromosome branch is the current primary paper
analysis; the all-scaffold branch shows how much of the signal depends on loci
whose assembly placement is unresolved. Both retain every sample.
</p>
</div>
